blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Interactive panoramic video generation aims to synthesize immersive 360° videos that remain visually coherent while following user-specified camera trajectories during exploration.
However, progress is limited by a coupled data-and-model gap: existing panoramic video datasets are often short, weakly annotated, or lack camera trajectories, while existing camera-controlled video generation models are designed for perspective videos and do not directly support panoramic geometry.
In this paper, we introduce MUGEN and Wan360 to address these limitations. MUGEN is a large-scale real-world panoramic video dataset tailored to interactive 360° world exploration, comprising over 1,300 hours of at least 4K panoramic videos with rich semantic and geometric annotations.
Built on MUGEN, we further present Wan360 , a camera-controllable interactive panoramic video generation model.
Panoramic videos are commonly represented by EquiRectangular Projection (ERP), which unfolds a spherical 360° view into a rectangular frame with cyclic longitude seams and pole distortions.
To this end, Wan360 introduces three parameter-free ERP-aware components: periodic longitude RoPE for seam-consistent positional encoding, ERP-aware padding for reducing boundary artifacts, and random roll yaw for consistent learning.
For camera control, Wan360 uses a panoramic Plücker embedding that represents camera motion with ERP rays rather than perspective pinhole rays.
Experiments show that MUGEN serves as a data foundation for panoramic world exploration, and that Wan360 enables high-quality, temporally coherent, camera-controllable 360° video generation.
blocks.zh:
互动全景视频生成旨在合成在探索过程中遵循用户指定摄像头轨迹的同时仍保持视觉一致性的浸润360°视频.
然而,进展受到数据与模型的结合差距的限制:现有的全景视频数据集往往很短,注释薄弱,或者缺乏相机轨迹,而现有的相机控制的视频生成模型是为视角视频设计的,并不直接支持全景几何.
在本文中,我们介绍了MUGEN和Wan360,以解决这些局限性。 MUGEN是一个针对交互式360°世界探索量身定制的大型现实世界全景视频数据集,包含超过1300小时的至少4K全景视频,并带有丰富的语义和几何注释.
在MUGEN上,我们进一步展示了Wan360,一个相机控制的交互式全景视频生成模型.
全景视频通常以Equi矩形投影(ERP)为代表,将球形360°的视野展开为长方形框架,具有循环经度的缝隙和杆形扭曲.
为此,Wan360引入了三个无参数的ERP-意识组件:定期经纬度ROPE用于切换一致的位置编码,ERP-意识粘贴以减少边界文物,随机滚动yaw用于一致学习。
对于相机控制,Wan360采用全景Plücker嵌入法,它代表了与ERP射线的相机运动,而不是视角针孔射线.
实验显示,MUGEN是全景世界探索的数据基础,而Wan360则能够实现高质量,时间一致性,相机可控360°视频生成.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Panoramic videos provide complete 360° visual observations of real-world environments, making them a natural medium for immersive world exploration in virtual reality, simulation, and embodied AI ( Yin et al., 2025 ; Chiariotti, 2021 ; Anderson et al., 2018 ) .
For such exploration to be truly interactive, a generative system must satisfy three requirements simultaneously: it should synthesize high-fidelity panoramic content, maintain temporal and spherical consistency over time, and follow user-specified camera trajectories during generation.
Recent advances in panoramic video generation have improved the visual quality of 360° videos ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Tan et al., 2025 ; Xie et al., 2025 ; Fang et al., 2025 ; Xia et al., 2025 ; Yin et al., 2025 ) , but interactive panoramic world exploration remains underdeveloped because both the data and the model architectures are still insufficient for controllable generation in dynamic real-world scenes.
blocks.zh:
全景视频提供完整的360°真实世界环境的视觉观察,使其成为虚拟现实中浸泡世界探索,模拟的自然媒介,并体现AI(Yin等人,2025年;Chiariotti,2021年;Anderson等人,2018年).
为了使这种探索真正具有互动性,基因系统必须同时满足三个要求:它应合成高真度全景内容,在一段时间内保持时间和球面的一致性,并在生成过程中遵循用户指定的相机轨迹.
近期全景视频生成的进步提高了360°视频的视觉质量(Wang等人,2024年;刘等人,2025年;Tan等人,2025年;谢等人,2025年;Fang等人,2025年;Xia等人,2025年;Yin等人,2025年),但由于数据和模型架构仍然不足以在动态现实世界场景中实现可控生成,互动全景世界探索仍然不发达.

blocks.en:
From the data perspective, existing panoramic video datasets are not designed for world exploration.
Generation-oriented datasets ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Xia et al., 2025 ) mainly provide short captioned clips, which are useful for text-conditioned panoramic synthesis but do not provide explicit camera-trajectory annotations.
Perception-oriented datasets ( Huang et al., 2023 ; Xu et al., 2025 ; Yan et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ) include masks, boxes, or tracking annotations, but they are typically limited in scale and duration and do not target camera control video generation.
As a result, prior datasets rarely combine high-resolution real-world panoramic videos, minute-level temporal extent, semantic annotations, and geometric annotations such as camera trajectories.
Lacking of such a dataset makes it difficult to train and evaluate models that can generate long, coherent, and controllable panoramic videos.
To address this data gap, we introduce MUGEN , shown in Figure 1 , a large-scale real-world panoramic video dataset tailored to interactive 360° world exploration.
MUGEN contains over 1,300 hours of high-fidelity panoramic videos at a resolution of at least 4K, with source videos longer than one minute and standardized one-minute clips for annotation and training.
Each clip is paired with rich semantic annotations, including captions, scene categories, actions, weather, crowd density, and locations, as well as geometric annotations including camera trajectories, instance masks, and depth.
To construct MUGEN, we design an automatic pipeline that collects panoramic videos from curated YouTube channels, performs format and content filtering, segments videos into minute-level clips, and annotates them using large multimodal models and geometry estimation tools.
We further construct MUGEN-HQ, a 300-hour high-quality subset selected by quality and diversity, to support efficient model training and evaluation.
blocks.zh:
从数据角度来看,现有的全景视频数据集并不是为世界探索设计的.
面向一代的数据集(Wang et al., 2024; Xia et al., 2025)主要提供短字幕片段,对文本条件全景合成有用,但并不提供清晰的相机-弹射说明.
认知导向数据集(黄 al等人,2023年;徐.等人,2025年;颜.等人,2024年;张 al等人,2025年b)包含口罩,盒,或跟踪说明,但一般在规模和持续时间上都有限制,不针对镜头控制视频生成.
因此,之前的数据集很少结合高分辨率真实世界全景视频,分钟时间范围,语义说明,镜头轨迹等几何注释.
由于缺乏这样一个数据集,很难培训和评价能够产生长、连贯和可控制的全景视频的模型。
为了弥补这一数据差距,我们引入了MUGEN,如图1所示,这是一个适合交互式360°世界探索的大规模现实世界全景视频数据集。
MUGEN包含超过1300小时的高纯度全景视频,分辨率至少为4K,源视频长于1分钟,并规范了1分钟的片段,用于注释和培训.
每个片段都配有丰富的语义说明,包括标题,场景分类,动作,天气,人群密度和位置,以及几何说明,包括相机轨迹,实例口罩,和深度.
为了构建MUGEN,我们设计了一个自动管道,从YouTube的频道收集全景视频,进行格式和内容过滤,将视频片段分解为分钟片段,并使用大型多式联运模型和几何估计工具进行注释。
我们进一步建造了MUGEN-HQ,这是一个按质量和多样性选择的300小时高质量子集,以支持有效的模式培训和评价。

blocks.en:
From the model perspective, directly extending existing video generation models to interactive panoramic generation is also non-trivial.
Panoramic videos are usually represented in equirectangular projection (ERP), whose geometry differs fundamentally from ordinary perspective frames: longitude is periodic, the left and right image boundaries correspond to the same seam, and the top and bottom rows collapse near the poles.
Treating ERP frames as standard rasters can therefore introduce seam artifacts, pole artifacts, and spherical inconsistencies.
To address this model gap, we propose Wan360 , a camera-controllable panoramic image-to-video model trained on MUGEN-HQ.
Wan360 is fine-tuned from the perspective camera-control baseline Wan2.2-Fun-5B-Control-Camera ( Wan et al., 2025 ) and adapts it to ERP panoramas through three parameter-free ERP-aware components. Periodic longitude RoPE enforces cyclic positional encoding along the horizontal longitude dimension, ERP-aware padding reduces seam artifacts in VAE encoding and decoding, and random roll yaw exposes the model to yaw-equivalent panoramic observations while preserving the corresponding camera trajectories.
For camera control, Wan360 uses a panoramic Plücker embedding ( Ji et al., 2025 ) , replacing perspective pinhole rays with ERP rays to enable trajectory conditioning without conventional camera intrinsics.
These components allow Wan360 to reuse the pretrained video generation baseline while avoiding additional trainable modules.
blocks.zh:
从模型视角来看,将现有的视频生成模型直接扩展到交互式全景生成也是非三角的.
全景视频通常以等距投影(ERP)表示,其几何学与普通视角框架有根本差异:经度是周期性的,左侧和右侧的图像边界对应同一接合线,上下行在柱子附近坍塌.
因此,将ERP框架作为标准光栅可以引入接合文物、杆状文物和球形不一致之处。
为了填补这个模型的空白,我们提议Wan360,一个在MUGEN-HQ训练的相机控制全景图像到视频模型.
Wan360从视角相机控制基线Wan2.2-Fun-5B-Control-Camera(Wan等人,2025年)进行了微调,并通过三个无参数的ERP-意识组件将其适应ERP全景. 定期经纬度RoPE沿水平经度维度执行环形位置编码,ERP-意识粘贴减少VAE编码和解码中的缝合文物,随机滚动yaw将模型暴露在yaw等同的全景观测中,同时保留相应的相机轨迹.
对于相机控制,Wan360使用全景Plücker嵌入式(Ji等人,2025年),用ERP射线取代了视角针孔射线,使得没有常规相机内在的轨迹调节成为可能.
这些组件使得Wan360可以重新使用预先训练的视频生成基线,同时避免额外的可训练模块.

blocks.en:
Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of both MUGEN and Wan360.
We evaluate the annotation quality of MUGEN and show that its semantic and geometric annotations provide reliable data support for interactive panoramic world exploration.
We further compare Wan360 with existing panoramic video generation methods and conduct ablations on its ERP-aware components.
The results show that Wan360 achieves strong panoramic video quality, temporal coherence, and camera-trajectory controllability, indicating that the improvements come from both the scale and quality of MUGEN and the proposed ERP-aware components.
blocks.zh:
实验证明了MUGEN和Wan360的功效.
我们评价MUGEN的注释质量,并表明其语义和几何注释为交互式全景世界探索提供了可靠的数据支持.
我们进一步将Wan360与现有的全景视频生成方法进行比较,并在其认识到企业资源规划系统的组件上进行模拟。
结果表明,Wan360实现了强大的全景视频质量、时间一致性和相机-导电控制性,表明改进来自MUGEN的规模和质量以及拟议的企业资源规划系统-意识组件。

blocks.en:
To sum up, our contributions are as follows:
(i) We propose MUGEN , a large-scale, long-duration, high-quality real-world panoramic video dataset for interactive panoramic world exploration, containing over 1,300 hours of videos with rich semantic and geometric annotations.
(ii) We present Wan360 , a camera-controllable panoramic video generation model that adapts to ERP geometry via three parameter-free ERP-aware components and a panoramic Plücker embedding.
(iii) Extensive experiments validate the annotation quality of MUGEN and the generation quality of Wan360.
blocks.zh:
总之,我们的贡献如下:
(i) 我们提议使用MUGEN,这是一个大规模、长期、高质量的真实世界全景视频数据集,用于互动全景世界探索,其中包含超过1 300小时的视频,内容丰富的语义和几何说明。
(二) 我们介绍Wan360,一个相机控制全景视频生成模型,通过三个无参数的ERP-意识组件和全景Plücker嵌入来适应ERP几何.
(三)广泛实验验证MUGEN的注释质量和Wan360的生成质量.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Panoramic Video Datasets
blocks.zh: 2.1 全景视频数据集

blocks.en:
Existing panoramic video datasets mainly support either generation or perception.
Generation-oriented datasets such as WEB360 ( Wang et al., 2024 ) and PANOVID ( Xia et al., 2025 ) provide captioned panoramic clips for text-conditioned synthesis, but their annotations are primarily semantic and lack explicit camera trajectories. 360-1M ( Wallingford et al., 2024 ) targets static novel view synthesis from frame pairs, PanFlow ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) curates a motion-rich panoramic dataset with frame-level pose and flow annotations tailored to optical-flow-conditioned motion control, whereas MUGEN provides trajectories and richer annotations, better suiting panoramic world exploration.
Perception-oriented datasets such as 360VOT/360VOTS ( Huang et al., 2023 ; Xu et al., 2025 ) , PanoVOS ( Yan et al., 2024 ) , and Leader360V ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) provide tracking or segmentation annotations, but are not designed for world exploration.
In contrast, MUGEN is the first dataset with large-scale real-world 360° videos, minute-level duration, high visual fidelity, semantic labels, and geometric annotations including camera trajectories, depth, and instance masks to support interactive world exploration.
blocks.zh:
现有的全景视频数据集主要支持生成或感知.
面向一代的数据集如WEB360(Wang等人,2024年)和PANOVID(Xia等人,2025年)为文字条件合成提供了字幕全景片段,但其说明主要是语义化的,缺乏明显的相机轨迹. 360-1M(Wallingford et al., 2024)针对的是帧对的静态小说视图合成,PanFlow(Zhang et al., 2026)对一个具有帧级姿势和流量说明的动态全景数据集进行校准,适合光学流条件运动控制,而MUGEN则提供轨迹和丰富的说明,更适合全景世界探索.
面向观念的数据集,如360VOT/360VOTS(Huang等人,2023年;徐等人,2025年) ,PanoVOS (Yan等人,2024年),和领队360V (Zhang等人,2025b)提供跟踪或分解说明,但并非为世界探索而设计.
相比之下,MUGEN是第一个拥有大规模真实世界360°视频,分钟持续时间,高视觉忠实度,语义标签,以及几何注释的数据集,包括相机轨迹,深度,实例口罩以支持互动世界探索.

blocks.en: 2.2 Panoramic Video Generation
blocks.zh: 2.2 全景视频生成

blocks.en:
Recent panoramic video generation methods adapt general video priors to ERP geometry using panorama-specific adapters ( Wang et al., 2024 ) , scalable generation ( Liu et al., 2025 ) , spherical or panorama-aware representations ( Park et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ; Xie et al., 2025 ; Xia et al., 2025 ) , and perspective-to-panorama lifting ( Tan et al., 2025 ; Lu et al., 2025 ; Fang et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025a ; Li et al., 2026 ) .
These works improve visual fidelity and scene coverage, but ERP panoramic video generation still requires geometry-aware mechanisms to handle longitude periodicity, boundary artifacts, and yaw-equivalent observations.
Wan360 achieves higher-quality panoramic video generation through three parameter-free ERP-aware components that address these geometric properties.
These components share related geometric intuitions with several prior works, but differ in how they are formulated and applied. PanoSplatt3R ( Ren et al., 2025 ) approximates ERP periodicity through head-wise rolled linear RoPE coordinates. In contrast, our Periodic Longitude RoPE is exactly cyclic for every head, leading to better continuity at the seam. PAR ( Wang et al., 2026a ) applies circular padding to panoramic image generation, whereas we extend it to the 3D video VAE for video generation. PanoDiffusion ( Wu et al., 2024 ) rotates the panorama during training, our Random Roll Yaw also rotates the camera trajectory simultaneously, thereby enhancing the diversity of camera trajectories during training.
blocks.zh:
近代全景视频生成方法利用全景特异性适配器(王等人,2024年),可伸缩生成(刘等人,2025年),球形或全景-感官表示法(朴等人,2026年;张等人,2025年a年;谢等人,2025年;夏等人,2025年),以及视角-泛景提升法(谭等人,2025年;吕等人,2025年;方芳等人,2025年;李等人,2025年a年;李等人,2026年).
这些作品提高了视觉忠心度和场景覆盖度,但ERP全景视频生成仍然需要几何意识机制来处理经纬周期,边界文物,以及等效的yaw观测.
Wan360通过解决这些几何属性的三个参数免费的ERP-意识组件,实现了更高的全景视频生成.
这些元件与前几部作品有着相关的几何直觉,但在如何形成和应用上有所不同. PanoSplatt3R(Ren等人,2025年)通过头向滚动的线性RoPE坐标来估计企业资源规划系统的周期。 与此相反,我们的周期经度率ROPE对每个头都是完全循环的,从而在接缝上实现更好的连续性. PAR(Wang等人,2026a)对全景图像生成应用圆形粘贴,而我们将其扩展至3D视频VAE用于视频生成. 泛射 (Wu等人,2024年)在训练期间旋转全景,我们的Random Roll Yaw也同时旋转相机轨迹,从而提高了训练期间相机轨迹的多样性.

blocks.en: 2.3 Camera-Controlled Video Generation
blocks.zh: 2.3 相机控制 视频生成

blocks.en:
Camera-controlled video generation typically injects control signals into the model in two ways: by converting camera motion into Plücker embeddings ( He et al., 2025a ) , or by adding explicit discrete control cues into the text prompts ( Wan et al., 2025 ) .
Existing methods mainly focus on conventional perspective video generation ( AlayaWorld Team et al., 2026a ; AlayaWorld Team et al., 2026b ; AlayaWorld Team et al., 2026c ; He et al., 2025b ; Sun et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ; Robbyant Team et al., 2026 ) .
Although PanoWorld-X ( Yin et al., 2025 ) , CamPVG ( Ji et al., 2025 ) , and OmniRoam ( Liu et al., 2026 ) enable camera-controlled interactive panoramic video generation, these methods operate primarily in static or quasi-static environments.
In contrast, Wan360 targets dynamic real-world panoramic world exploration, emphasizing controllable generation under natural, diverse, and unconstrained conditions.
blocks.zh:
相机控制的视频生成通常通过两种方式向模型注入控制信号:将相机运动转化为普吕克嵌入(He等人,2025a),或者在文本提示中加入明显的离散控制提示(Wan等人,2025年).
现有方法主要侧重于传统视角视频生成(Alaya World Team等人,2026a;AlayaWorld) Team等人,2026b;阿拉亚世界 Team等人,2026c;He等人,2025b;Sun等人,2025;Zhu等人,2026;Robbyant Team等人,2026).
虽然PanoWorld-X(Yin等人,2025年),CamPVG(Ji等人,2025年),OmniRoam(Liu等人,2026年)可以进行相机控制的交互式全景视频生成,但这些方法主要在静态或准静态环境中运行.
与此相对照,Wan360针对的是动态现实世界全景世界探索,强调在自然,多样,不受约束的条件下可控制的生成.

blocks.en: 3 MUGEN Curation
blocks.zh: 3 MUGEN 校正

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Data curation pipeline for MUGEN. We collect 2,893 hours of panoramic source videos from YouTube, preprocess continuous footage into consecutive one-minute clips for scalable annotation, annotate each clip with semantic and geometric information using Qwen3-VL ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , GPT-4o ( Hurst et al., 2024 ) , and ViPE ( Huang et al., 2025 ) , filter clips by visual quality, overlays, and trajectory validity, and finally sample MUGEN-HQ for model training. The pipeline yields MUGEN (1,318 hours) and MUGEN-HQ (300 hours).
blocks.zh: 图2:MUGEN的数据校准管道。 我们从YouTube收集了2,893小时全景源视频,将连续的连续视频处理成1分钟的可伸缩注释片段,用Qune3-VL(Yang等人,2025年),GPT-4o(Hurst等人,2024年)和VIPE(Huang等人,2025年)对每个片段进行语义和几何信息注释,并按视觉质量、覆盖和轨迹有效性进行过滤片段,最后对MUGEN-HQ进行模型培训样本。 输油管输出MUGEN(1,318小时)和MUGEN-HQ(300小时)。

blocks.en:
To address the lack of large-scale, high-quality, richly annotated panoramic video datasets tailored to world exploration, we introduce MUGEN. Figure 2 presents the data curation pipeline for our MUGEN dataset.
We begin by collecting panoramic videos from YouTube, focusing on diverse real-world environments.
To ensure high data fidelity, we apply strict format filtering based on resolution, bitrate, and frame rate.
The filtered videos are then preprocessed into minute-level clips through intro/outro trimming, shot boundary detection, and standardized transcoding.
Each clip is annotated with comprehensive semantic and geometric information using multimodal models, followed by content-based quality filtering to produce the final MUGEN dataset.
Furthermore, we construct MUGEN-HQ by sampling a high-quality subset with the most reliable and diverse annotations.
MUGEN also provides panoramic video supervision for AlayaVista ( Tan et al., 2026 ) , which studies streaming world modeling from panoramic states to perspective observations.
blocks.zh:
为了解决缺乏适合世界探索的大规模,高质量,内容丰富的全景视频数据集的问题,我们引入了MUGEN. 图2显示了我们MUGEN数据集的数据编码流程。
我们首先收集YouTube的全景视频, 关注不同的现实世界环境。
为了确保高数据忠贞性,我们采用基于分辨率,比特率和帧率的严格格式过滤.
过滤的视频随后通过内演/外演剪切,射击边界检测,以及标准化的转码,预加工成分级剪辑.
每个片段都附有使用多式联运模型的综合语义和几何信息注释,然后进行基于内容的质量过滤,以产生最后的MUGEN数据集.
此外,我们通过取样一个具有最可靠和最多样化说明的高质量子集来构建MUGEN-HQ。
MUGEN还为AlayaVista(Tan等人,2026年)提供全景视频监督,后者研究从全景状态到视角观测的流媒体世界模型.

blocks.en: 3.1 Data Acquisition and Preprocessing
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据购置和预处理

blocks.en:
We use YouTube as the primary source for diverse real-world panoramic videos.
We manually curate leading panoramic video channels and search the YouTube Data API with queries such as “360 tour”, then review the retrieved results to exclude non-real-world content such as simulation or rendered scenes.
This stage yields 9,544 candidate source videos.
blocks.zh:
我们使用YouTube作为各种真实世界全景视频的主要来源。
我们手动管理主要全景视频频道,并以“360巡演”等查询方式搜索YouTube Data API,然后审查检索结果,排除模拟或制作场景等非现实世界内容。
这一阶段产生了9,544个候选源视频.

blocks.en:
We further query video metadata and apply format filtering to retain high-fidelity panoramic videos.
We remove non-panoramic videos and videos with frame rates below 30 FPS, resolutions below 4K, or bitrates below 4 kbps.
For the remaining videos, we download the highest available resolution and best-quality audio, resulting in 2,893 hours of raw panoramic footage.
All retained source videos are longer than one minute.
blocks.zh:
我们进一步查询视频元数据,并应用格式过滤来保留高真实度全景视频.
我们删除帧率低于30 FPS、分辨率低于4K或比特率低于4kbps的非广度视频。
对于其余的视频,我们下载了现有最高的分辨率和最高质量的音频,导致2,893小时的原始全景片段.
所有保留源视频都超过1分钟.

blocks.en:
For preprocessing, we first verify file integrity and discard corrupted videos.
We trim the first and last minute of each source video to remove common intro and outro segments.
Because online videos are often edited, we use TransNetV2 ( Souček and Lokoč, 2020 ) to detect shot boundaries and keep only temporally continuous segments.
Following Sekai ( Li et al., 2025b ) , we accelerate shot-boundary processing with PyNvVideoCodec and CVCUDA.
Each continuous segment is partitioned into consecutive non-overlapping 60-second clips, which makes large-scale annotation tractable and provides a consistent training unit.
The clips are transcoded to H.265 at the original resolution and frame rate, with audio re-encoded to AAC at 48 kHz.
This process produces 137,209 one-minute clips totaling approximately 2,287 hours before content filtering.
blocks.zh:
对于预处理,我们首先核查文件完整性,并丢弃损坏的视频.
我们修剪每个源视频的第一和最后一分钟,去除常见的内演和外演段.
由于网络视频经常被编辑,我们使用TransNetV2(Souček和Lokoč,2020年)来检测镜头边界,只保持时间连续的片段.
继Sekai(Li等人,2025年b)之后,我们与PyNvVideo Codec和CVCUDA加速了镜头边界处理.
每个连续段被分割成连续不重叠的60秒片段,这使得大规模注音可拉动,并提供一个连贯的训练单元.
片段按原始分辨率和帧速率转码为H.265,音频重编码为AAC48千赫.
这个过程在内容过滤前总共产生137,209个1分钟的剪辑,总共约2,287小时.

blocks.en: 3.2 Annotation
blocks.zh: 3.2 注释

blocks.en: MUGEN provides two groups of annotations: semantic annotations for content generation and geometric annotations for interactive camera control.
blocks.zh: MUGEN提供两组说明:内容生成语义说明和交互式相机控制几何说明.

blocks.en: 3.2.1 Semantic Annotations
blocks.zh: 3.2.1 语义说明

blocks.en:
Because ERP panoramas are difficult for vision-language models to parse directly, we project each ERP clip into six cube faces with a 90° × \times 90° field of view and attach explicit face labels.
We use Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct ( Yang et al., 2025 ) to generate detailed clip-level narratives of approximately 250 words, describing scene layout, visible objects, events, and camera motion.
To support different training and evaluation settings, we also provide event-agnostic captions and interval captions at 5s/10s granularity.
We further prompt Qwen3-VL with YouTube metadata to predict structured attributes, including weather, time of day, crowd density, scene category, and action.
Following SpatialVID ( Wang et al., 2026b ) , we refine coarse indoor/outdoor labels into fine-grained scene categories and introduce action labels tailored to world exploration.
For geographic information, we use GPT-4o ( Hurst et al., 2024 ) to extract location tags from video metadata; clips with ambiguous or missing locations are marked as unspecified .
blocks.zh:
由于ERP全景对于视觉语言模型来说是难以直接解析的,我们把每个ERP剪辑投影到6个立方体的面部,以90°×\times 90°的视野,并附加明显的面部标签.
我们使用Qune3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct(Yang等人,2025年)生成大约250字的详细剪辑级叙事,描述场景布局,可见物体,事件,以及相机运动.
为了支持不同的培训和评价设置,我们还在5s/10s颗粒度提供事件不可知字幕和间隔字幕。
包括天气、时间、人群密度、场景分类和行动。
空间VID 之后 (Wang等人,2026b),我们把粗糙的室内/室外标签细化为精细的场景类别,并引入适合世界探索的动作标签.
对于地理信息,我们使用GPT-4o(Hurst等人,2024年)从视频元数据中提取位置标记;带有模糊或缺失位置的片段标记为未指明.

blocks.en: 3.2.2 Geometric Annotations
blocks.zh: 3.2.2 几何说明

blocks.en:
For camera-controllable generation, each clip requires trajectory annotations.
We compare VGGT ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , MegaSAM ( Li et al., 2025c ) , and ViPE ( Huang et al., 2025 ) on sampled panoramic clips, and choose ViPE because it directly supports panoramic video input and produces more coherent camera trajectories in our setting.
We use ViPE to estimate camera trajectories, instance masks, and depth for each clip.
Generating geometric annotations for the full dataset requires over 30,000 GPU hours.
blocks.zh:
对于相机可控的生成,每个片段都需要轨迹说明.
我们比较VGGT(Wang等人,2025年),MegaSAM (Li et al.,2025c),和VIPE(Huang et al.,2025)在采样全景片段上,选择VIPE,因为它直接支持全景视频输入,并在我们的设定中产生更一致的相机轨迹.
我们用VIPE来估计相机的轨迹,例口罩,以及每个片段的深度.
生成完整数据集的几何说明需要超过30,000 GPU小时.

blocks.en: 3.3 Quality Filtering
blocks.zh: 3.3 质量过滤

blocks.en:
Raw web videos inevitably contain poor lighting, blur, overlays, stitching artifacts, or unreliable trajectories.
We therefore apply four content filters before forming MUGEN.
blocks.zh:
原始的网络视频不可避免地包含灯光差,模糊,覆盖,缝合文物,或者不可靠的轨迹.
因此,我们在形成MUGEN之前应用了四个内容过滤器.

blocks.en: 3.3.1 Luminance
We compute the mean luma value of each clip and discard clips outside the range [40, 215] to remove underexposed or overexposed content.
blocks.zh: 我们计算在范围[40,215]以外的每一片段和丢弃片段的平均润湿值,以去除未充分接触或过度接触的内容.

blocks.en: 3.3.2 Visual Quality
blocks.zh: 3.3.2 视觉质量

blocks.en: We score clips with COVER ( He et al., 2024 ) and remove clips below 0.7, which typically contain severe blur, distortion, or compression artifacts.
blocks.zh: 我们用CDER(He等人,2024年)来评分剪辑,并删除0.7以下的剪辑,这些剪辑通常包含严重模糊,扭曲,或压缩文物.

blocks.en: 3.3.3 Overlays
We project each ERP clip into six perspective views and use Qwen3-VL ( Yang et al., 2025 ) to flag subtitles, watermarks, and nadir patches.
blocks.zh: 我们将每个企业资源规划剪辑片段投放到六个视角,并使用Qune3-VL(Yang等人,2025年)标出字幕、水印和纳迪尔补丁。

blocks.en: 3.3.4 Trajectory Validity
blocks.zh: 3.3.4 轨迹有效性

blocks.en:
We filter clips whose estimated camera trajectories contain chaotic paths, temporal discontinuities, or abnormal rotations.
After filtering, MUGEN contains 1,318 hours of high-quality one-minute clips from 6,446 unique source videos.
blocks.zh:
我们过滤那些相机轨迹 包含混乱路径 时间不连续 或异常旋转的剪辑
在过滤后,MUGEN包含来自6,446个独特源视频的1,318小时高质量1分钟的剪辑.

blocks.en: 3.4 MUGEN-HQ Sampling
blocks.zh: 3.4 MUGEN-HQ取样

blocks.en:
Although MUGEN is suitable for large-scale training and evaluation, model development often requires a smaller subset with high visual quality and balanced coverage.
We therefore construct MUGEN-HQ, a 300-hour subset used for training Wan360.
We first rank clips by COVER score and retain the top 70% as a quality-filtered pool.
We then perform stratified sampling across scene categories, camera-motion patterns, action types, and weather conditions.
This strategy preserves high visual quality while improving diversity in both scene content and controllable camera motion.
MUGEN-HQ contains clips from 4,023 unique source videos.
blocks.zh:
虽然MUGEN适合进行大规模培训和评价,但模型开发往往需要一个较小的子集,具有较高的视觉质量和均衡的覆盖范围.
因此,我们建造了MUGEN-HQ,这是一个300小时的子集,用于培训Wan360。
我们通过COVER得分排名第一 并保留了前70%作为精密过滤池。
然后,我们进行分层取样,涉及场景类别、摄影机运动模式、动作类型和天气条件。
这一策略保持了较高的视觉质量,同时提高了场景内容和可控相机运动的多样性.
MUGEN-HQ包含来自4,023个独有源视频的片段.

blocks.en: 3.5 Dataset Analysis
blocks.zh: 3.5 数据集分析

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Statistics of semantic attributes and camera trajectories in MUGEN. Left: semantic attribute distributions. Right: camera trajectory statistics.
blocks.zh: 图3:MUGEN语义属性和相机轨迹统计. 左:语义属性分布. 对 摄像头轨迹统计

blocks.en:
MUGEN covers diverse semantic and motion conditions for panoramic world exploration.
As shown in Figure 3 , the dataset spans multiple weather types, times of day, crowd-density levels, scene categories, and action types.
The trajectory statistics show substantial variation in translation length, rotation magnitude, angular speed, and dominant motion direction.
These properties provide the semantic diversity and trajectory diversity needed to train and evaluate camera-controllable panoramic generation models.
We will release metadata and processing scripts to support transparent reuse.
blocks.zh:
MUGEN涵盖了全景世界探索的各种语义和运动条件.
如图3所示,数据集涵盖多种天气类型,日间时间,人群密度水平,场景类别,动作类型.
轨迹统计显示,在翻译长度、旋转量、角速和主运动方向方面有很大差异。
这些特性提供了培训和评价相机可控全景生成模型所需的语义多样性和轨迹多样性.
我们将发布元数据和处理脚本,以支持透明的再利用.

blocks.en: 4 Wan360 Model
blocks.zh: 4 湾360 型号

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Architecture of Wan360. Wan360 is a camera-controllable interactive panoramic video generation model towards world exploration conditioned on an input panorama, a text prompt, and a target camera trajectory. To adapt the perspective baseline to panoramic geometry, Wan360 introduces three parameter-free ERP-aware components: periodic longitude RoPE for cyclic longitude encoding, ERP-aware padding for seam-continuous VAE features, and random roll yaw for yaw-equivalent trajectory augmentation. A panoramic Plücker embedding converts ERP pixels into spherical rays and injects trajectory conditions through the pretrained control adapter.
blocks.zh: 图4:万360建筑. Wan360是一个相机可控交互式全景视频生成模型,以输入全景为条件面向世界探索,文本提示,以及目标镜头轨迹. 为了使视角基线适应全景几何,Wan360引入了三个无参数的ERP-意识组件:周期经度ROPE用于循环经度编码,ERP-意识粘贴接缝连续VAE特性,以及随机滚动yaw用于等效轨迹增强. 全景 Plücker 嵌入式将 ERP 像素转换成球状射线,并通过预先训练的控制适配器注入轨迹条件.

blocks.en:
We present Wan360 , a panoramic image-to-video (I2V) generation model that generates ERP videos from an input panorama, a text prompt, and a user-specified camera trajectory.
Wan360 is fine-tuned from a perspective camera-control video generation baseline to preserve its strong generation and control priors, but this baseline cannot be directly applied to panoramas.
ERP videos contain cyclic longitude seams and pole singularities, and panoramic cameras do not follow the perspective pinhole model.
Naive fine-tuning would therefore introduce seam artifacts, spherical inconsistencies, and mismatched camera-control signals.
blocks.zh:
Wan360是一个全景图像到视频(I2V)生成模型,
Wan360从一个透视相机控制视频生成基线进行微调,以保持其强大的生成和控制前身,但这一基线不能直接应用于全景.
ERP视频包含循环经纬度的缝隙和杆状奇点,全景摄像头不遵循视角针孔模型.
因此,自然微调将引入缝合文物、球形不一致和相机控制信号不匹配。

blocks.en: 4.1 Component Overview
blocks.zh: 4.1 构成部分概览

blocks.en:
Figure 4 shows the overall architecture.
Wan360 addresses the ERP geometry mismatch with three components that add no trainable parameters. Periodic Longitude RoPE ( Section 4.2 ) makes longitude positional encoding seam-consistent, ERP-Aware Padding ( Section 4.3 ) reduces boundary artifacts in VAE encoding and decoding, and Random Roll Yaw ( Section 4.4 ) creates yaw-equivalent panorama-trajectory training pairs.
For camera control, a Panoramic Plücker Embedding ( Section 4.5 ) replaces the baseline’s pinhole ray-condition generator with an ERP ray generator, enabling intrinsics-free trajectory conditioning.
blocks.zh:
图4显示了总体结构。
Wan360处理ERP几何不匹配的问题,有三个组件不添加可训练参数. 定期经纬度 RoPE(第4.2节)使经纬度位置编码的接缝一致,ERP-Aware Padding(第4.3节)减少VAE编码和解码中的边界文物,Random Roll Yaw(第4.4节)制造了等效的全景-射程训练对.
在摄像机控制方面,一台全景Plücker Embedding(第4.5节)用ERP射线发电机取代基线的针孔射线条件发电机,从而能够进行内在无轨迹调节。

blocks.en: 4.2 Periodic Longitude RoPE
blocks.zh: 4.2 定期经度率

Using the original positional encoding therefore introduces an artificial discontinuity at the panorama seam.
Periodic Longitude RoPE replaces only the longitude part of the positional encoding with a cyclic formulation, while keeping the temporal and latitude parts unchanged for compatibility with the pretrained baseline.

Because ρ k ​ ( u + W ) = ρ k ​ ( u ) \rho_{k}(u+W)=\rho_{k}(u) , the positional code is continuous across the ERP seam.
This makes tokens near the two horizontal boundaries geometrically consistent and reduces seam-related artifacts during fine-tuning.

blocks.en: 4.3 ERP-Aware Padding
blocks.zh: 4.3 ERP-Award Padding系统

blocks.en:
The VAE in the baseline uses local convolutions, whose default boundary handling assumes that image edges have no continuation.
For ERP panoramas this assumption is incorrect, because pixels at the two horizontal borders are neighbors on the sphere.
ERP-Aware Padding exposes this cross-boundary neighborhood by using longitude-cyclic padding during VAE encoding and decoding.
For any VAE feature map z z , horizontal padding is defined as z ~ t , v , u = z t , v , u mod W , \tilde{z}_{t,v,u}=z_{t,v,\,u\bmod W}, (2) so convolutional neighborhoods that cross the left or right border are sampled from the opposite side of the panorama.
This prevents the autoencoder from injecting artificial boundary artifacts into latent features and decoded frames.

基线中的VAE使用局部演化,其默认边界处理假设图像边缘没有续作.
对于ERP全景,这个假设是不正确的,因为两个横向边界的像素是球体上的邻居.
ERP-Aware Padding通过在VAE编码和解码过程中使用经纬度循环制备,暴露了这一跨界街区.

这使得自动编码器无法将人工边界文物注入潜在的特征和解码框架。

blocks.en: 4.4 Random Roll Yaw
blocks.zh: 4.4 随机卷轴

blocks.en:
ERP panoramas have no canonical yaw orientation: horizontally rolling a panorama corresponds to rotating the world around the vertical axis.
If the model only sees the yaw distribution in the collected videos, it may overfit to dataset-specific orientations and become less robust under user-specified trajectories.
Random Roll Yaw augments each training sample with a yaw-equivalent version by rolling the ERP video and applying the same yaw rotation to the camera trajectory.

如果模型只看到所收集的视频中的yaw分布,它可能会过度适应数据集特定方向,并在用户指定的轨迹下变得不那么坚固.

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en: 5.1 Evaluation of Dataset Quality
blocks.zh: 5.1 数据集质量评价

blocks.en:
We conduct a user study to evaluate the annotation quality of MUGEN from three complementary aspects: long-form text descriptions, structured category labels, and camera trajectories.
We randomly sample 1,000 one-minute clips from MUGEN and recruit 10 volunteers for human verification.
For each aspect, every sampled clip is independently reviewed by all 10 volunteers.
An annotation is considered valid if at least seven volunteers judge it to be correct or usable.
blocks.zh:
我们进行一项用户研究,从三个互补方面评价MUGEN的注释质量:长式文字说明、结构化的分类标签和相机轨迹。
我们随机抽取了来自MUGEN的1000个1分钟短片,并招募了10名志愿者进行人类验证.
每个方面,每个抽样的片段都由所有10名志愿人员独立审查。
如果至少有7名志愿人员认为该说明正确或可用,则该说明被视为有效。

blocks.en: 5.1.1 Text Descriptions
blocks.zh: 5.1.1 文字说明

blocks.en:
Volunteers judge whether each long-form description matches the clip content, events, and camera motion; hallucinated or contradictory descriptions are marked as invalid.
94.7% of the sampled descriptions are judged to be accurate, indicating that the text annotations provide reliable semantic supervision for panoramic video generation.
blocks.zh:
志愿者判断每个长式描述是否与剪辑内容,事件,镜头动作相匹配;幻觉或矛盾描述被标记为无效.
94.7%的抽样描述被判断为准确,表明文本说明为全景视频生成提供了可靠的语义监督.

blocks.en: 5.1.2 Category Labels
blocks.zh: 5.1.2 类别标签

blocks.en:
Volunteers judge whether the provided category labels are supported by the video; ambiguous or visually unverifiable labels are treated as invalid.
The final valid ratio reaches 95.3%, showing that the automatically generated category labels are sufficiently accurate for dataset analysis and controlled training.
blocks.zh:
志愿人员判断所提供的类别标签是否由视频支持;模棱两可或无法辨认的标签被视为无效。
最终有效比例达到95.3%,表明自动生成的类别标签对于数据集分析和受控训练足够准确.

blocks.en: 5.1.3 Camera Trajectories
blocks.zh: 5.1.3 相机轨迹

blocks.en:
Volunteers inspect trajectory-overlaid clips and judge whether each trajectory is plausible and aligned with the observed camera motion; obvious drift or wrong-direction cases are marked as unusable.
The resulting usable trajectory ratio is 92.4%, validating that MUGEN provides reliable camera-control annotations for interactive panoramic video generation.
blocks.zh:
志愿人员检查轨迹覆盖的弹夹,判断每个轨迹是否合理,是否与所观察到的相机运动一致;明显漂移或方向错误的案件被标记为无法使用。
由此产生的可用轨迹比为92.4%,验证MUGEN为交互式全景视频生成提供了可靠的相机控制说明.

blocks.en: 5.2 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.2 实验设置

blocks.en: 5.2.1 Training Details
blocks.zh: 5.2.1 培训细节

blocks.en:
Wan360 is fine-tuned from the Wan2.2-Fun-5B-Control-Camera ( Wan et al., 2025 ) baseline.
We fine-tune it on MUGEN-HQ to generate 161 161 frames at 1920 × 960 1920{\times}960 resolution, sampled at 16 16 FPS from the 30 30 FPS source videos.
Training is conducted on 8 × 8\times NVIDIA H200 GPUs for 10 10 epochs with a learning rate of 𝟏 × 𝟏𝟎 − 𝟓 \mathbf{1{\times}10^{-5}} .
blocks.zh:
Wan360从Wan2.2-Fun-5B-Control-Camera(Wan等人,2025年)基线中微调.
我们在MUGEN-HQ上进行微调,以1920×960 1920\times}960分辨率生成161 161帧,从30个FPS源视频中以16 16 FPS样本.
培训时间为8×8时 NVIDIA H200 GPU,为10个学期,学习率为1×10−5\mathbf{1}10×5}。

blocks.en: 5.2.2 Evaluation Data
blocks.zh: 5.2.2 评价数据

blocks.en:
We randomly select 200 video samples that are excluded from training.
From them, we curate a final test set of 100 videos by stratifying the samples according to camera trajectory patterns and scene categories.
blocks.zh:
我们随机挑选200个视频样本 不包括在训练中
从它们中,我们通过根据相机轨迹模式和场景类别对样本进行分解,对100个视频进行最终测试。

blocks.en: 5.2.3 Metrics

For reconstruction-oriented quality, we report FVD ( Unterthiner et al., 2018 ) , SSIM ( Wang et al., 2004 ) , LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) , and PSNR against held-out reference videos.
For perceptual and temporal quality, we use VBench++ ( Huang et al., 2024 ) .
For camera control, following CamCtrl ( He et al., 2025a ) , we annotate the trajectory of each generated video using ViPE ( Huang et al., 2025 ) and compute the translation error ( TransErr ) against the input trajectory.
blocks.zh:
对于面向重建的质量,我们报告FVD(Unterthiner et al., 2018),SSIM(Wang et al., 2004),LPIPS(Zhang et al., 2018),以及PSNR针对被搁置的参考视频.
对于知觉和时间质量,我们使用V Bench++ (黄等,2024).
关于相机控制,在CamCtrl(He等人,2025年a)之后,我们用VIPE(Huang等人,2025年)对每个生成的视频的轨迹进行注释,并对照输入轨迹计算翻译错误(TransErr).

blocks.en: 5.3 Evaluation of Model Performance
blocks.zh: 5.3 评价示范业绩

blocks.en: 5.3.1 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 5.3.1 阅读研究

blocks.en:
Block (I) of Table 1 evaluates the three ERP-aware components in Wan360.
Removing Periodic Longitude RoPE, ERP-aware padding, or random roll yaw weakens the overall balance between video quality and camera control.
The full model achieves the best overall score, indicating that the three components are complementary for fine-tuning a perspective video generation baseline for panoramic video generation.
blocks.zh:
表1的块(I)评价了Wan360中三个了解企业资源规划系统的组件。
取消定期经纬度 RoPE、ERP-aware 粘贴或随机滚动的yaw会削弱视频质量与相机控制之间的总体平衡。
全模式实现最佳整体分数,表明三个组件对于全景视频生成的视角视频生成基线的微调是互补的.

blocks.en: 5.3.2 Disentangling Model and Data
blocks.zh: 5.3.2 拆分模型和数据

blocks.en:
Block (II) isolates the contributions of architecture and data.
We train Wan360 using the same training recipe while replacing MUGEN-HQ with data from GenEX ( Lu et al., 2025 ) or ViewPoint ( Fang et al., 2025 ) .
Under the same evaluation protocol, Wan360 trained on these alternative datasets improves several metrics over the corresponding original methods, but remains behind Wan360 trained on MUGEN-HQ.
This result suggests that Wan360 contributes meaningful model-side gains, while the scale, diversity, and annotation quality of MUGEN-HQ are essential for the final performance.
blocks.zh:
块(II)隔离了架构和数据的贡献.
我们使用同样的培训方法培训Wan360,同时用来自GenEX(Lu等人,2025年)或VideoPoint(Fang等人,2025年)的数据取代MUGEN-HQ。
根据同一评估协议,接受过这些替代数据集培训的Wan360比相应的原始方法改进了数个度量,但仍落后于接受过MUGEN-HQ培训的Wan360.
这一结果表明,Wan360有助于产生有意义的模式方面收益,而MUGEN-HQ的规模、多样性和注释质量对最终业绩至关重要。

blocks.en: 5.3.3 Comparison with Existing Methods
blocks.zh: 5.3.3 与现行方法的比较

blocks.en:
Block (III) evaluates Wan360 against representative panoramic video generation methods under the same held-out test set.
Compared with prior methods, Wan360 substantially reduces FVD and LPIPS while improving SSIM, PSNR, and video quality, indicating better frame-level fidelity and temporal realism.
Among methods with explicit camera-control evaluation, Wan360 also achieves the lowest TransErr, showing more accurate trajectory following in dynamic real-world panoramas.
blocks.zh:
Block(III)根据代表性全景视频生成方法对Wan360进行同一套搁置测试.
与先前的方法相比,Wan360在改善SSIM,PSNR和视频质量的同时,大幅降低了FVD和LPIPS,表明帧级的忠诚度和时间现实性更好.
在有明确相机控制评价的方法中,Wan360还实现了最低的TransErr,在动态现实世界全景中显示出更准确的轨迹.

blocks.en: 5.4 Qualitative Examples
blocks.zh: 5.4 定性实例

Figure 6 provides qualitative comparisons with representative methods.

In contrast, Wan360 better preserves panoramic structure, visual details, and temporally coherent motion.

4K4DGen(Li et al.,2025a)经常产生有限的表面运动,GenEX(Lu et al.,2025)在大运动下引入了文物和几何扭曲,CubeComposer(Li et al.,2026)往往产生动态较少的视频,OmniRoam(Liu et al.,2026)受到静态场景假设的限制.
相比之下,Wan360更好地保存了全景结构,视觉细节,以及时间上一致的运动.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we take a step toward interactive panoramic world exploration, where the central goal is to generate immersive 360° videos that remain coherent while following user-specified camera trajectories in dynamic real-world scenes.
This task requires both suitable annotated data and a model that can respect panoramic geometry under camera control.
To this end, MUGEN provides large-scale, high-quality real-world panoramic videos with rich semantic and geometric annotations, including explicit camera trajectories for controllable generation.
Built on MUGEN, Wan360 fine-tunes a perspective camera-control video generation baseline for ERP panoramas through periodic longitude RoPE, ERP-aware padding, random roll yaw, and a panoramic Plücker embedding.
Experiments show that MUGEN provides effective data support for the task, and that Wan360 generates panoramic videos with strong visual quality, temporal coherence, and trajectory controllability.
The proposed MUGEN and Wan360 establish a practical foundation for camera-controlled interactive panoramic world exploration in real-world environments.
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,我们朝着互动全景世界探索迈出了一步,中心目标是在动态现实世界的场景中,在遵循用户特定镜头轨迹的同时,生成浸润360°的视频保持连贯.
这项任务既需要合适的附加说明的数据,也需要一个在相机控制下能够尊重全景几何的模型.
为此,MUGEN提供了大规模,高质量的真实世界全景视频,带有丰富的语义和几何注释,包括用于可控生成的清晰的相机轨迹.
在MUGEN上,Wan360通过定期经纬度RoPE、ERP-意识粘贴、随机滚珠和全景Plücker嵌入,微调了ERP全景摄像头的图像生成基线。
实验显示MUGEN为任务提供了有效的数据支持,Wan360生成全景视频,具有强烈的视觉质量,时间一致性,以及轨迹可控性.
拟议的MUGEN和Wan360为在现实世界环境中进行相机控制的交互式全景世界探索奠定了实际基础。

blocks.en: 6.1 Limitations
blocks.zh: 6.1 限制

blocks.en:
We use ViPE ( Huang et al., 2025 ) to perform 3D reconstruction on videos generated by Wan360. In static scenes, the reconstructed scene structure and relative object positions remain generally stable, while the estimated camera trajectories are smooth and continuous. However, strict 3D consistency is not guaranteed, particularly in dynamic scenes with independently moving objects. Explicitly enforcing geometric and temporal consistency remains an important direction for future work.
Wan360 currently generates fixed-length clips and does not yet support real-time or unbounded long-horizon generation, where error accumulation remains an open challenge. In addition, MUGEN’s data primarily comes from the real world. In future work, we will consider extending it to other domains, such as animation and games.
blocks.zh:
我们使用VIPE(Huang等人,2025年)在Wan360生成的视频上进行3D重建. 在静态场景中,重建后的场景结构和相对物体位置总体上保持稳定,而估计的相机轨迹则平滑连续. 然而,严格的3D一致性并不能保证,特别是在动态场景中与独立移动的物体. 明确执行几何和时间一致性仍然是今后工作的一个重要方向。
Wan360目前产生固定长度的剪辑,尚不支持实时或无约束的长视距生成,其中误差积累仍然是一个公开的挑战. 此外,MUGEN的数据主要来自现实世界. 在今后的工作中,我们将考虑将其扩大到其他领域,例如动画和游戏。
